=== custom/defaults
# Generated by Samuori from custom recipe tooling-base 1.0.0. Do not edit; change the recipe instead.
FROM docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef AS build
ARG port
ARG tag
WORKDIR /src
COPY [".","."]
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npm_token,target=/run/secrets/npm_token,required=true ["/bin/sh","-c","apt-get update"]
RUN --network=none --mount=type=secret,id=npm_token,target=/run/secrets/npm_token,required=true ["make","base"]
FROM build AS final
ARG port
ARG tag
COPY --from=build --chown=10001:10001 ["/src/out","/app"]
ENV MODE="production"
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.version"="base"
EXPOSE 8080
USER 10001
CMD ["/app/run","base"]
